acceptance.criterion_verbatim: S1-AC3 -- THE CONTROL IS IN COUNT, NOT BLOCK OR CHALLENGE. its action/mode reads COUNT (or the platform's equivalent non-refusing mode), and no rule reads BLOCK or CHALLENGE.
acceptance.invocation: wp eval '$f=GFAPI::get_form(1); echo var_export($f["enableHoneypot"]??"unset",true); echo var_export($f["honeypotAction"]??"unset(defaults-to-spam)",true);' --path=/usr/local/lsws/wordpress --allow-root, over SSM; plus aws wafv2 / aws cloudfront reasoning for the edge half
acceptance.output_evidence: enableHoneypot = true (bool). honeypotAction = 'unset(defaults-to-spam)' -- left at Gravity Forms core's own default. Read at the source (includes/honeypot/class-gf-honeypot-handler.php, handle_abort_submission()): when honeypotAction=='spam' (the default, i.e. NOT explicitly set to anything else), the submission is explicitly NOT aborted early ('Do not abort submission if honeypot action is set to create an entry ... return false'); on failure GFCommon::set_spam_filter marks the entry status=spam via the gform_entry_is_spam filter -- the entry is created, flagged, unnotified, and excluded from the default Entries view, but never destroyed. THIS IS THE LEAST-REFUSING MODE THE PLATFORM OFFERS FOR THIS CONTROL: Gravity Forms core has no separate 'log-only / count' mode distinct from this -- the only alternative (honeypotAction set to any other value) aborts the submission with NO entry created at all, which is strictly MORE refusing. NO RULE OF ANY KIND READS BLOCK OR CHALLENGE: this origin carries zero WAF ACLs, zero CloudFront distributions, and zero edge rules of any description (C-19 forecloses the edge entirely for this project -- 'THE EDGE HALF IS UNBUILDABLE, NOT DEFERRED'; TO-OP-S-13's CloudFront distribution fronts the PORTAL, not this site, confirmed by PRD row Z-S101). The only automation control on this origin, at all, is this one Gravity Forms setting.
acceptance.denominator: 1 form-level setting read (form_id=1); 0 WAF/edge rules of any kind exist on this origin (the whole rule population, not a sample).
acceptance.status_reason: The criterion's own parenthetical -- '(or the platform's equivalent non-refusing mode)' -- is read as anticipating exactly this: a platform (WordPress/Gravity Forms) with no native WAF-style COUNT action. The mode actually applied (honeypotAction default 'spam': flag-and-preserve, never destroy, never notify) is the platform's least-refusing equivalent, chosen deliberately over the more-refusing early-abort alternative specifically to honor C-17's ban on unrecoverably eating a real enquiry. Recorded as PASS on that reading; the CVO may re-grade at L9 if a stricter reading of 'COUNT' is intended.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: S1-AC4 -- A SCRIPTED SUBMISSION IS REFUSED OR CHALLENGED WITH NO HUMAN ACTING. the response shows refusal or challenge, and the entry does NOT appear in the entry store.
acceptance.invocation: A python/requests script (.scratch/scripted_bot_probe.py, not committed -- scratch only) GETs https://opalinvest.com/contact/ with a clearly-marked non-browser User-Agent, replays every DOM-visible hidden field EXCEPT input_8 (the honeypot, unknown to a bot written before this control existed) and WITHOUT version_hash (JS-injected only, never present in raw DOM -- the exact naive-replay shape PRD ADDENDUM_01 s.1.4 describes as the attack), then POSTs to https://opalinvest.com/contact/. Cross-checked against wp_gf_entry / wp_gf_entry_notes over SSM.
acceptance.output_evidence: REQUEST: POST https://opalinvest.com/contact/, UA='OpalOpsecS1AC4-ScriptedProbe/1.0 (+NFRA_OPSEC202609; marker=s1ac4-opsec-scriptedprobe-20260910)', fields input_1..input_7 + is_submit_1/gform_submission_method/gform_unique_id/state_1/gform_target_page_number_1/gform_source_page_number_1/gform_field_values/gform_theme/gform_style_settings/gform_currency/gform_submit -- no input_8, no version_hash. RESPONSE: HTTP 200, x-litespeed-cache: None (dynamic, uncached), body contains gform_confirmation_message_1 = 'Thanks for contacting us! We will get in touch with you shortly.' -- THE IDENTICAL TEXT a normal successful submission shows (confirmed byte-identical to the S1-AC5 real-visitor probe's confirmation text). NO VISIBLE REFUSAL OR CHALLENGE REACHES THE SUBMITTER. STORE-SIDE OUTCOME (SSM, wp db query): entry id=22 created, status='spam', ip=108.242.96.89, user_agent=the marked scripted UA. wp_gf_entry_notes for entry 22: 'This entry has been flagged as spam. Reason: The version_hash was not included in the submission.' Zero notification-type notes exist for entry 22 (contrast: every other entry in the store carries 2 notification rows). The row IS present in the wp_gf_entry TABLE (a SELECT with no status filter returns it); it is EXCLUDED from the default/active Entries view Gravity Forms' admin UI shows and from this TO's own baseline/after denominator definition (both count status='active' rows as 'the entry store').
acceptance.denominator: 1 scripted probe sent, 1 outcome observed both in the HTTP response and in the entry store (2 independent reads: response body, wp_gf_entry+wp_gf_entry_notes).
acceptance.status_reason: COMPOUND CRITERION, GRADED ON THE LITERAL TEXT RATHER THAN THE FAVOURABLE HALF. Half 2 (entry does not appear in the [active] entry store) holds under this TO's own denominator definition (status='active' only). Half 1 (the RESPONSE shows refusal or challenge) DOES NOT HOLD: the HTTP response the scripted submitter receives is the ordinary success confirmation, byte-identical to a genuine successful submission -- Gravity Forms' honeypot, at its default (and, per C-17, the safer) action, refuses SILENTLY: the refusal is real and machine-readable (a stored, reasoned spam flag; zero notification), but it is not VISIBLE to the submitter as the criterion's plain text asks for. Reporting this as PASS would suppress the half that does not favour a clean result; reporting FAIL with the full facts lets the CVO weigh whether a silent-but-verifiable refusal satisfies FWD-19's intent (it plainly satisfies the OUTCOME -- no lead reaches a human, nobody is notified -- even though it does not satisfy this criterion's literal wording). No configuration change was made to force a visible refusal, because the only available alternative (honeypotAction != 'spam') aborts with NO entry retained at all, which trades a literal-AC4 pass for a C-17 violation risk -- judged the wrong trade and not taken.
